t: The Blyss 1500W Electric Wall-Mounted Radiant Panel Heater provides efficient heating for various professional environments. Its radiant panel technology ensures a quick rise in temperature when needed, making it ideal for workshops, offices, or small commercial spaces up to 15m². This electric heater features variable heat settings and an electronic thermostat with an LCD display for precise control. Safety is enhanced with overheat protection and a thermal breaker. Users can benefit from 7-day and 24-hour programmable options, including four pre-set programmes, allowing for tailored heating schedules. The IPX4 rating confirms suitability for damp areas, and the unit is hard-wired for a secure installation.
